description: This file defines the class SlidingTabStrip, a custom Android View extending LinearLayout, used for rendering a scrollable tab strip with indicators and separators, typically as part of a tab layout component.

classes.name: SlidingTabStrip
classes.description: A custom View for displaying a colored indicator, dividers, and borders within a tab layout, supporting dynamic coloring and position updates.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.TabColorizer
classes.description: An interface for providing custom indicator and divider colors for tabs.

classes.name: SimpleTabColorizer
classes.description: A default implementation of TabColorizer that uses arrays of colors for indicators and dividers.

methods.name: setCustomTabColorizer
methods.description: Assigns a custom colorizer for tab indicator and divider colors.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Sets colors for the tab indicator, overriding the default colorizer.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Sets divider line colors between tabs, overriding the default colorizer.

methods.name: onViewPagerPageChanged
methods.description: Updates the selected tab position and offset during page scrolls.
